original_findings.basis: stringByte(state5) now reprocesses non-ST byte in string state, so the UTF8 lead and rawST retain their boundaries; fixed independent literal vectors final raw PASS.

utfSequence tracks all valid lead widths during sequence/drain, nonC1 scalar does not reset to normal; utfCode>=utfMin prevents overlong encoding from impersonating C1; original two literals final raw PASS.
rawC1 check now precedes bare-ESC dispatch; raw/UTF8 CSI/OSC literals final raw PASS.
Original exact/over ASCII and complete UTF8 literals now PASS and bytes are counted, but newly reachable oversized Alt invalid-prefix path prematurely resets to normal; see K115-R1-01.
inputActive checks gate consume recursion and each event/issue delivery against running/session/stop; final actual native E4+x raw has issues1,x0,caught=false,cleanup1,released=true.

batch replaces persistent keys/issues rather than clear; paste allocation is replaced on overflow, completion, new paste and finish. Remaining sequence backing capacity is bounded by maxSequenceBytes plus constant paste-prefix allowance, endPrefix at most6 and scalar metadata O(1). No history-sized field remains on normal return.

findings.title: 已超限 Alt UTF8 遇到非续字节时提前退出 drain
contract: K002 once SequenceTooLong then drain through final; no leaked digit/final
findings.expected: 一次 SequenceTooLong@0；E4 已令普通 ESC 序列超过1，后续数字1与final A均在drain中消耗，只有末尾text B。
findings.actual_source_trace: E4 在184–186调用appendSequence，设置drained=true并报SequenceTooLong。下一31不是UTF8续字节：160清utfRemaining，非utfSequence分支166无条件state=0，168重试31；普通文本分支发1，随后A也发text，得到1/A/B。
findings.secondary_case: feed([ESC,C2]); timeout() 在max1按已冻结裁决报SequenceTooLong并进入drain；之后feed([31,41,42])经过同一166/168路径，同样泄漏1/A/B。
findings.interpretation: K002普通坏UTF8的独立字节重试不允许解除已由更先SequenceTooLong建立的隔离；F002明确普通非string首次资源/畸形问题后仍drain。本例没有新ESC、标量边界C1或raw03取消，也未在数字1前到final。
findings.requested_change: 分离未超限Alt坏UTF8的正常重试与已超限Alt的隔离路径：后者将当前非续字节交回同一drain规则，直到final/契约明确取消；不把drained候选直接state=0后按normal重试。
findings.validation: 独立固定 literal 的所有两块切分/bytewise，以及ESC+C2/max1→timeout→31 41 42控制；仅SequenceTooLong@0和text B。保留未超限Alt InvalidUtf8 lead-offset与真实新ESC/C1/raw03取消。
findings.evidence_mode: Deterministic fixed-source trace only; no new runtime reproduction claimed.

controller_ruling_assessment: ESC+C2/max1未完成时在timeout/finish确认SequenceTooLong而非IncompleteInput，与K001原始字节预算及K002已超限隔离优先一致；完整C1按F007/F002新引导自身规则处理。未发现需推翻该裁决的正文冲突；其保留drain要求同样受K115-R1-01影响。
evidence_reuse: review-r1-final-02 original01–05 exits0, ordinary pure and both I015 pure results0; review-r1-lint-02 exit0 with zero error severity and701 warnings. Earlier affected native raws remain bound to their recorded earlier source.patch, not a claim of full final dispatcher execution.
limits: No new build/probe/suite, author contact/self-assessment, full asset audit or product/test/spec/main changes. TASK116 bundle/host checks not covered.
